title: Device and access lifecycle
description: For employee devices and SaaS tools: managed and encrypted devices, single sign-on, automated provisioning and same-day removal of access on departure.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-124 Rev. 2, Guidelines for Managing the Security of Mobile Devices in the Enterprise
RFC 7644, System for Cross-domain Identity Management: Protocol
NIST SP 800-46 Rev. 2, Guide to Enterprise Telework, Remote Access, and Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) Security

rules.instruction: Enrol every device that reaches company data in device management, including personally owned devices through a managed profile or app.
rules.verification: Compare the device management export with the list of employees and check that unmanaged devices are listed with an action.

rules.instruction: Enforce disk encryption, screen lock, automatic updates and remote wipe through device management policies.
rules.verification: Read the policy export and check each of the four settings is enforced for the device types in use.

rules.instruction: Connect each SaaS tool to the identity provider with single sign-on, or record the exception and its owner.
rules.verification: Compare the SaaS inventory with the identity provider's application list and check that each exception has an owner.

rules.instruction: Provision and deprovision accounts automatically from the identity provider, for example through SCIM, where the tool supports it.
rules.verification: Check the provisioning settings of the tools that support it.

rules.instruction: Disable a leaver's accounts and devices on their last working day and keep the record.
rules.verification: For the last leavers, compare the departure date with the account disable dates in the identity provider log.
